title: release-train weekly prep notes - 2026-06-10
content:
Meeting: Release Train / Launch Readiness weekly sync
Date: 2026-06-10
Owner (notes): Camila Rivera
Attendees (planned): Samir Patel, Evan Ramirez, Leah Park, Jordan Lee (ops), Maya Singh (product)

Purpose: Quick go/no-go health check across infra, runtime, QA, rollout plan, and monitoring. Surface highest risks and owners for action items before final sign-off next week.

AGENDA (30m):
- Quick status round (3m each)
- Top blockers & risks (10m)
- Go/no-go checklist review (10m)
- Action items and owners (5m)

SUMMARY / QUICK RECOMMENDATION:
- Current leaning: CONDITIONAL GO. Major infra capacity and long-tail latency risks are being addressed but need final smoke test results and a short rollback drill. If smoke tests pass by 2026-06-11 18:00 PDT and canary metrics stable by 2026-06-12 12:00 PDT, recommend final GO.

GO/NO-GO CHECKLIST (owner — status — notes):
1) Infrastructure capacity & GPU pool sizing — Samir Patel — amber — autoscale policy tested, but observed 5% eviction on p3-edge during load test; mitigation: reserve one additional pool and enable pre-warming. Smoke test tomorrow.
2) Serving runtime smoke tests (basic LLM responses, streaming) — Evan Ramirez — in_progress — current run: 85% pass; failures tied to a new kernel selection path for 8-bit models. Repro steps filed RUNTIME-781.
3) Model artifact & weights availability (S3 verification + checksum) — Leah Park — green — all artifacts uploaded; checksum mismatch for quantized-v2 noted earlier fixed 2026-06-09 22:30.
4) DB migrations / config rollouts — Camila Rivera — green — migration window scheduled; feature-flagged rollout ready.
5) Canary plan + rollout strategy — Jordan Lee — amber — canary groups defined (1% / 5% / 20%), rollback hooks present but need final smoke-sanity in canary.
6) Monitoring / alerting & runbooks — Maya Singh — amber — alerts created (latency P95, error spikes, OOM). Runbook draft exists; needs playbook owner sign-off.
7) Legal / compliance review (data retention, KMS) — Priya Kapoor (sec/compliance) — green — pending one minor KMS key rotation note (documented).
8) Customer comms + release notes — Product comms (Maya Singh) — in_progress — draft release notes in GH, internal comms scheduled.
9) Observability retention & cost guardrails — Observability team — amber — retention policy for debug logs extended temporarily; need finance sign-off on cost delta.
10) Rollback drill tested (partial rollback + warmup) — Samir Patel + Ops — scheduled 2026-06-11 09:00 PDT — planned drill to validate warmup time and KV-cache invalidation.

TOP RISKS (high-level):
- Kernel selection regression for quantized models causing 15-20% increased latency for long sequences (impacts pay-per-token SLAs). Owner: Evan.
- Evictions on p3-edge during peak test; could translate to transient 500s under burst. Owner: Samir.
- Canary monitoring gaps: need synthetic test that exercises multi-segment streaming + function-calls. Owner: Maya/Jordan.

OPEN BLOCKERS (items that must clear before final GO):
- Outstanding runtime bug RUNTIME-781 (kernel path) — block for 8-bit models — target fix + retest by EOD 2026-06-10; if not fixed, restrict canary traffic to non-quantized variants.
- Rollback drill results — must pass core rollback scenarios by 2026-06-11 12:00 PDT.
- Smoke-test pass rate >= 95% across supported seq lengths by 2026-06-11 18:00 PDT.

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due):
- Evan: finish patch for RUNTIME-781, push hotfix branch, and run full smoke suite (due 2026-06-10 20:00 PDT).
- Samir: provision extra reserved pool and run eviction mitigation test; report pool warm-up time (due 2026-06-11 09:00 PDT).
- Jordan: finalize canary traffic rules and ensure automated rollback trigger on P95 > target for 10m (due 2026-06-11 12:00 PDT).
- Maya: add synthetic multi-segment streaming test to canary job and update runbook with play-by-play (due 2026-06-11 12:00 PDT).
- Leah: confirm artifact checksums and dependency graph for quantized-v2; post final verification comment on RUNTIME-781 (due 2026-06-10 23:00 PDT).
- Camila: prepare communications checklist for internal stakeholders and exec FYI template (due 2026-06-12 09:00 PDT).
- Priya: quick KMS rotation note sign-off or acceptable exception (due 2026-06-11 12:00 PDT).
- Observability: provide cost delta estimate for extended retention (due 2026-06-11 17:00 PDT).

NOTES TO SELF / SCRATCHES: (rough)
- If RUNTIME-781 not resolved, fallback option: pin canary to quantized-v1 + route traffic to dedicated pool with older kernel selection. Pros: lower immediate risk; cons: cost + slightly higher latency.
- Consider temporary customer-facing rate limit for longer sequences during first 48h to reduce exposure to long-tail P95 spikes.
- Quick check: confirm that Dedicated reserved pool billing is prorated correctly for projected extra pool.

MEETING TL;DR (what I will say):
- We are in conditional GO; two actionable blockers (runtime kernel + rollback drill). Teams are aligned on fixes; if both clear in the next 48 hours and smoke/canary metrics are stable, we recommend final GO.

FOLLOW-UP / NEXT MEETING:
- Short status check tomorrow 2026-06-11 10:00 PDT (15m) to review smoke tests and rollback drill outcome.
- Final sign-off meeting 2026-06-12 13:00 PDT (30m) — stakeholders: Eng leads, SRE, Product, Legal.

LINKS (quick):
- Smoke test dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-internal/smoke-tests/2026-06-10
- JIRA: RUNTIME-781 (https://jira.redwood-inference.com/browse/RUNTIME-781)
- JIRA: INFRA-4523 (https://jira.redwood-inference.com/browse/INFRA-4523)
- Rollout plan: https://confluence.redwood-inference.com/display/REL/Release+Train+2026-06

END
